extDescription.message: Solves the daily LinkedIn Tango puzzle for you. Fills in every sun and moon in one click, or on its own when the board loads.

hintAny.message: Play unlimited puzzles, no daily limit →

stStuck.message: Board found, but no solution exists

stWaiting.message: Board found · start the round to solve it

errBusy.message: A solve is already running on this board.

errNoBoard.message: Board not found or still loading.

errNoSolution.message: No solution exists for this board.

errUnsolved.message: The board still isn't solved. Try again.

errClick.message: A click didn't register. Try again.

errCluesGuesses.message: Couldn't tell clues from guesses on this board.

errNoPad.message: Number pad not found. Start the round first.

errDigit.message: A digit didn't register. Try again.

errClearPatches.message: Couldn't clear the patches already on the board.

errPatchDraw.message: Patch $1 of $2 wouldn't draw. Try again.

errNoTiling.message: No rectangle tiling found for this board.

errPathTime.message: Couldn't find a path in time. The board may have been misread.

errNoPath.message: No path exists for this board.

errClearPath.message: Couldn't clear the path already drawn. Undo it and try again.

errPathStopped.message: The path stopped after $1 of $2 cells. Try again.
